privacy_policy.content:
Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website.

Information We Collect

  • Usage data such as pages visited, time on site, and device/browser details.
  • Cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality and measure performance.

Google Ads

We may display advertisements served by Google Ads. Google may use cookies or device identifiers to show relevant ads and measure ad performance. You can learn more about how Google uses data and control ad personalization in your Google Ads settings.

How We Use Data

  • To provide and improve our services.
  • To analyze traffic and usage trends.
  • To display and measure advertising.

Your Choices

You can disable cookies in your browser settings. Some site features may not work properly without cookies.

Contact

If you have questions about this policy, please contact us via the website contact form.
